title: Changes of Model on Equipment Rental and Demo Kit Called For by the Collective's Own Instruction
content:
Where a rider is being taught by the collective's own instructors, a change of kit part-way through the hire is as likely to have come from the instruction as from the rider, and the share of the Equipment Rental and Demo change fee charged is smaller for it.

## The rule

Where the rider holds a Snowsports School booking for the season, and the school account carries at least one session delivered in the month before the change is priced, the instructor referred share of the fee is charged. The instructor referred share is 50 per cent.

Where the rider holds a Snowsports School booking for the season and the school account carries no session delivered in that month, the school booked share is charged instead. The school booked share is 80 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the share charged.

## The conditions in combination

| Snowsports School booking held for the season | Sessions delivered on the school account in the month before the change is priced | Share of the package's change fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 1 or more | 50 per cent |
| yes | none | 80 per cent |
| no | not counted | nothing under this heading |

The window is the month running back from the day the change is priced. A booking held for the season with its last session delivered longer ago than that carries none inside the window and takes the second row.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical change

Take an agreement on a package whose change fee is 15.00 USD.

- The rider holds a school booking for the season and the school account shows a session delivered 10 days ago: 50 per cent of 15.00 USD, which is 7.50 USD.
- The rider holds a school booking for the season and the school account shows nothing delivered inside the month: 80 per cent of 15.00 USD, which is 12.00 USD.
- The rider holds no school booking for the season: nothing under this heading changes the share.

## Point of judgement

**Whose booking is read.** The booking read is one held by the rider for the season the agreement belongs to; the sessions counted are those the school account shows delivered inside the month before the change is priced.
